name: Ilduro Zeren
appearance: 40s. Mud to the thigh. Ash goad-stick.
and_yet: Croons to the sows by name.
sayings: Pigs don't scream at nothing. Mine scream every night.
wants: Pigs calm at night before farrowing.
does_not_want: His brother's militia in his pens.
knows: Tikka sleeps in the third sty.
family: Younger brother to Captain Durvin; the Zerens own the pens.
dm_notes: The pigs smell Nighthowl gnolls who scout the pen edges by night for escaped goblins.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
